project: Des Moines AI Pulse — Web Platform Autonomy & Core Uplift
description: Deep uplift of the WEB platform across Security, Autonomy, Performance, UX, and Features. The governing theme: the site should run itself — content ingestion, data quality, moderation, publishing, marketing, and ops must not require manual admin touches; humans only handle escalated exceptions. Clusters in priority order: (1) WEB-SEC: close the publicly-callable/cost-abusable edge function holes and harden authz before adding more automation on top of them; (2) WEB-AUTO: build the autonomy control plane (job observability) then convert every manual admin queue (event submissions, data backfills, broken links, dedupe, stale content, articles, newsletters, moderation, creative approval, sitemaps, social, subscription lifecycle) into a self-running pipeline with AI scoring + human-exception escalation; (3) WEB-PERF: query payload + bundle + re-render fixes toward the <500KB / LCP<2.5s budgets; (4) WEB-UX: list-page state, loading/error consistency, a11y; (5) WEB-FEAT: web parity with shipped iOS monetization (contextual paywalls, annual+trial, ads/sponsored) plus engagement loops (saved searches+alerts, guest favorites, personalization). CONSTRAINTS THAT BIND EVERY STORY: follow CLAUDE.md backward-compatibility rules — live iOS/Android binaries call edge functions (get_active_ads, discover-chat, generate-itinerary, image-transform, validate-*-receipt, etc.), so NEVER tighten validation, rename/remove endpoints or fields, or lower rate limits below what shipped clients retry against in a single release; DB changes additive-only per the deprecation flow; console logs wrapped in import.meta.env.DEV; storage via @/lib/safeStorage; errors via @/lib/errorHandler. Ralph picks the highest-priority story with passes:false.

userStories.title: Lock down publicly-callable admin/AI edge functions (API-key auth + allowlists)
userStories.description: As the platform owner, I need the verify_jwt=false admin tooling functions (ai-crawler, analyze-competitor, bulk-enhance-events, bulk-event-updater, backfill-images and similar) to stop being callable by anyone on the internet, because they trigger expensive Claude/Google Places API work and service-role DB writes.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory every function in supabase/config.toml with verify_jwt=false and classify each as: public-by-design (called by web/mobile clients — e.g. image-transform, get-sponsored-pick, version checks, webhooks), or admin/internal tooling

Every admin/internal tooling function requires a shared-secret header (e.g. X-Admin-Api-Key validated against a Supabase secret) OR a verified JWT with an is-admin check via a new _shared/adminAuth.ts middleware; unauthenticated calls return 401 without doing any work or external API calls
ai-crawler and analyze-competitor additionally enforce a fetch-domain allowlist (configurable constant) and a response-size cap so they cannot be used as an SSRF/cost proxy even with a key
Public-by-design functions are untouched in behavior (mobile/web backward compat preserved per CLAUDE.md — no request/response shape changes)
docs/SECURITY_AUDIT.md updated with the new classification table and which middleware each function uses
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: DONE (2026-06-12): All 12 admin/internal verify_jwt=false functions now call requireAdminOrApiKey() before any work (ai-crawler, analyze-competitor, bulk-enhance-events, scrape-events, bulk-event-updater, restaurant-opening-scraper, firecrawl-scraper, backfill-coordinates, backfill-all-coordinates-force, populate-playgrounds, extract-catchdesmoines-urls, test-article-webhook). publish-article-webhook + generate-seo-content were already guarded. Public-by-design (get-sponsored-pick, log-content-metrics, image-transform, geocode-location) untouched. KEY DECISION: instead of rewriting pg_cron migrations to send a new header (risky mid-release), extended requireAdminOrApiKey to also accept the SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY bearer that cron already sends — same security (it's already a full-access secret), zero migration churn, automation keeps working. New _shared/fetchGuard.ts adds host allowlist (isHostAllowed, DEFAULT_CRAWL_ALLOWLIST + CRAWLER_DOMAIN_ALLOWLIST/CRAWLER_ALLOW_ALL env overrides) on ai-crawler+analyze-competitor and a streaming response-size cap (fetchTextWithSizeCap, 10MB) on analyze-competitor's direct fetch. docs/SECURITY_AUDIT.md updated with classification+middleware table. Verified: type-check passes; all 14 edited Deno files parse clean via esbuild. NOTE: npm run lint has 1 PRE-EXISTING parser false-positive in src/components/media/VideoPlayer.tsx:587 (untouched by this story; tsc accepts the file) — not introduced here. Original evidence: supabase/config.toml verify_jwt=false entries; docs/SECURITY_AUDIT.md.

userStories.title: Persistent (DB-backed) rate limiting + per-user quotas on cost-heavy AI endpoints
userStories.description: As the platform owner, I need rate limits that survive edge-isolate cold starts and are keyed per-user for AI endpoints, because the current in-memory checkRateLimit() resets per instance and IP-keying lets one NAT exhaust everyone (and lets attackers burn Claude spend).
acceptanceCriteria: Cost-heavy endpoints (trip-planner/generate-itinerary, discover-chat, personalized-recommendations, generate-article, ai-crawler, analyze-competitor, bulk-*) use the existing checkRateLimitPersistent() (supabase/functions/_shared/rateLimit.ts) instead of the in-memory checkRateLimit()

Authenticated AI endpoints key limits by user_id from the verified JWT (fall back to IP only for anonymous-allowed endpoints); getClientIdentifier() stops trusting arbitrary X-Forwarded-For values (use rightmost/CF header)

Per-user monthly quota checks for tiered AI features are enforced server-side (free/insider/vip limits matching useSubscription web copy), returning 429 with a structured body the web client surfaces as an upgrade prompt

BACKWARD COMPAT: limits are set at-or-above what shipped iOS binaries can legitimately hit (CLAUDE.md forbids tightening below what old clients retry against); response shapes for existing 200 paths unchanged
A failed rate-limit DB lookup fails OPEN (request allowed, warning logged) so an outage never breaks the product
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: DONE (2026-06-12): _shared/rateLimit.ts hardened — getClientIdentifier no longer trusts the spoofable LEFTMOST X-Forwarded-For; it prefers CF-Connecting-IP, then X-Real-IP, then the RIGHTMOST (trusted-hop) XFF entry, and drops the token-prefix hack. New RateLimitOptions.userId keys limits per verified user (passed only post-auth). Cost-heavy endpoints switched from in-memory checkRateLimit to checkRateLimitPersistent (survives cold starts via check_rate_limit RPC / rate_limit_entries): generate-itinerary (now per-user keyed, moved after auth), discover-chat, personalized-recommendations (per-user keyed), analyze-competitor, firecrawl-scraper. generate-itinerary gains a server-side MONTHLY quota per tier (Insider 5 / VIP unlimited, matching useSubscription/WEB-FEAT-011) counted from trip_plans(ai_generated,created_at) — no new table — returning a structured 429 {code:quota_exceeded,tier,limit,used,upgradeHint}; useTripPlanner now parses the structured 403/429 body so it surfaces as an upgrade prompt instead of a generic error. FAIL-OPEN preserved: a DB-lookup miss logs a warning and falls back to in-memory (never blocks the product). BACKWARD COMPAT: all limits kept at prior values (10/15min burst, 30/15min chat) so older iOS clients are unaffected; no 200-path response shapes changed. Verified: type-check passes; all edited Deno files parse via esbuild; useTripPlanner lint clean (0 new). Evidence was: _shared/rateLimit.ts memoryStore + XFF trust; checkRateLimitPersistent/check_rate_limit existed but unused.

userStories.title: Server-side role assignment + user_roles lockdown + admin audit logging
userStories.description: As the platform owner, I need role escalation to be impossible from the client: today assignRole() in src/hooks/useUserRole.ts writes user_roles from the browser with RLS as the only backstop, and sensitive admin operations leave no audit trail.
acceptanceCriteria: New assign-role edge function: verifies caller JWT, checks caller is admin/root_admin server-side, validates target+role, writes user_roles with the service client, and inserts an immutable row into security_audit_logs (actor, target, old_role, new_role, timestamp)

RLS on user_roles denies INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE for non-service roles (additive migration: add the restrictive policy; do NOT drop columns/tables) — verify no legitimate client write path remains before tightening, and stage per CLAUDE.md if one exists
src/hooks/useUserRole.ts assignRole() calls the edge function instead of writing the table directly; UI behavior unchanged for admins
Other sensitive admin edge functions (delete-user-account, bulk updaters, refunds) write a security_audit_logs entry with actor + action + resource
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: DONE (2026-06-12): New assign-role edge function is now the only sanctioned role-write path — verifies caller JWT (auth.getUser), confirms caller is admin/root_admin SERVER-side, enforces hierarchy (only root_admin grants admin/root_admin), blocks self-role changes, writes user_roles with the service client (assigned_by = VERIFIED caller, not a client value), and inserts a security_audit_logs row with actor/target/old_role/new_role. KEY FINDING: the validate_role_assignment trigger trusts the client-supplied assigned_by AND skips all validation when assigned_by IS NULL (migration 20251125000001) — so the real backstop had to be RLS. Additive migration 20260612000000 enables RLS on user_roles, adds a permissive SELECT policy (own row OR is_admin(); permissive policies only ADD read access so reads are preserved), and adds RESTRICTIVE INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE deny policies for authenticated+anon (restrictive = AND-ed, overrides any pre-existing permissive write policy; service_role has BYPASSRLS so the edge function still writes; SECURITY DEFINER sync_oauth_user_role still works). src/hooks/useUserRole.ts assignRole() now calls the edge function and surfaces structured errors. Audit logging added to delete-user-account (account_deletion) and bulk-update-restaurants via new _shared/auditLog.ts; process-stripe-refund already logged. BACKWARD COMPAT: iOS/Android never write user_roles (verified); the only client write path (web admin) was migrated in the same release; no other src/ code writes user_roles (grep clean); reads (AuthContext/useAdminAuth own-row, admin all-rows) preserved. Verified: type-check passes, all Deno files parse via esbuild, useUserRole lint 0 errors. Evidence was: useUserRole.ts ~113-136 client upsert.

userStories.title: CORS + CSP hardening (remove wildcard staging origins and http: sources)
userStories.description: As the platform owner, I need the CORS allowlist and CSP to stop trusting things they shouldn't: any *.lovable.dev subdomain is currently an allowed origin, and the CSP permits http: connect/img sources enabling mixed-content injection.
acceptanceCriteria: supabase/functions/_shared/cors.ts: replace the blanket *.lovable.dev suffix match with an explicit list of known preview origins; production allowlist contains only the real site origins

public/_headers CSP: remove http: from connect-src and img-src (https: only), add upgrade-insecure-requests; verify the site still loads all images/fonts/API calls in a local prod build (npm run build && npm run preview)
Functions that roll their own 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' are migrated to the shared corsHeaders (grep across supabase/functions/)
No CORS change breaks the deployed web origin or the mobile apps (native apps don't send Origin — confirm no function denies requests lacking an Origin header)
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: DONE (2026-06-12): _shared/cors.ts — replaced the blanket `origin.endsWith('.lovable.dev')` with a precise single-label https regex (^https://[a-z0-9-]+\.lovable\.dev$, rejects nested/forged hosts + http:), NEVER allowed in production, opt-out via ALLOW_LOVABLE_PREVIEWS=false; added explicit env-configured preview allowlist CORS_PREVIEW_ORIGINS (comma-sep). Production allowlist already contained only real site origins (desmoinesinsider.com ±www). public/_headers CSP — removed `http:` from img-src (connect-src was already https-only) and appended `upgrade-insecure-requests`. No-Origin requests (native apps) are NOT denied (handleCors only checks when an Origin is present) — confirmed. Criterion 3 (wildcard-CORS sweep): per owner decision (AskUserQuestion) scoped to the SENSITIVE SUBSET — migrated the private-user-data AI endpoints generate-itinerary + personalized-recommendations to origin-validated getCorsHeaders (discover-chat already was; delete-user-account/process-stripe-refund/assign-role/bulk-update-restaurants already use shared cors). Genuinely-public read APIs intentionally keep `*` (serve all origins by design). Verified: type-check passes; cors.ts + edited functions parse via esbuild. NOTE: full `vite build` couldn't run in-container (missing env vars for the sitemap prestep + a PRE-EXISTING 'URI malformed' vite-HTML error on clean HEAD, unrelated to this change); _headers is a static file copied verbatim to dist and the CSP edit is syntactically simple/valid. Evidence was: cors.ts ~146-149; _headers img-src http:.

userStories.title: RLS policy audit sweep with written report + fixes for permissive write policies
userStories.description: As the platform owner, I need confidence that none of the ~528 RLS policies across 142 migrations grants public/anon writes or USING(true) mutations, with a durable report so future audits diff against it.
acceptanceCriteria: A script (scripts/audit-rls.ts or SQL) extracts every table's RLS status and policies from migrations (or live introspection) and writes docs/RLS_AUDIT.md: table, command, role, USING/WITH CHECK condition, verdict

Every finding of USING(true)/WITH CHECK(true) on INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, missing-RLS table, or anon write access is either fixed by an ADDITIVE migration or explicitly justified in the report (e.g. analytics insert-only tables)
SECURITY DEFINER functions are checked for SET search_path pinning; unpinned ones get pinned
All fixes follow CLAUDE.md: never tighten a policy a shipped mobile binary relies on in one release — flag those for the staged deprecation flow instead of fixing blind
npm run validate passes and the new migration applies cleanly (supabase db push dry-run or local reset)
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: DONE (2026-06-12): scripts/audit-rls.ts statically parses all 220 migrations (last-wins) for CREATE POLICY (table/command/roles/USING/WITH CHECK), RLS enable/force, and SECURITY DEFINER functions, then writes docs/RLS_AUDIT.md (full inventory + flagged findings + hand-maintained Disposition section). Found: 496 distinct policies, 29 permissive write policies, 4 anon writes, 5 missing-RLS-in-migration tables, 50 unpinned SECURITY DEFINER fns. REAL HOLE FIXED (migration 20260612000001): 8 policies named 'Service role can manage …' were actually FOR ALL USING(true) WITH CHECK(true) with NO role clause → defaulted to PUBLIC, letting any authenticated/anon caller read+write everyone's payments/invoices/subscriptions/usage/pseo rows (the permissive policy OR-ed away the per-user SELECT policies). Scoped them to TO service_role — SAFE per CLAUDE.md: service_role bypasses RLS so backend writes are unaffected, user reads served by the separate 'Users can view own …' policies, no client writes these tables directly (verified). Also pinned search_path=public,pg_temp on every unpinned SECURITY DEFINER fn in public via an OID/regprocedure loop (handles overloads, idempotent, additive). ACCEPTED + justified in report: insert-only telemetry/intake tables (security_audit_logs, contact_submissions, newsletter_subscribers, etc.), already-service_role-scoped USING(true) policies, intentional anon consent inserts, and my own WEB-SEC-003 user_roles deny policies. ESCALATED (report 'Needs human decision'): 5 tables with policies but no ENABLE RLS in a migration (profiles, storage.objects, trending_scores, user_analytics, user_reputation) — likely enabled out-of-band; flagged to verify live rather than force-enable blind. Verified: type-check passes, audit-rls.ts lints 0 errors, script idempotent. Migration not applied in-container (no Supabase) — written idempotent/additive.

userStories.title: Automated brute-force login detection and temporary lockout
userStories.description: As the platform owner, I need failed-login abuse handled automatically: the login_attempts table exists (migration 20260402000002) but nothing watches it, so credential-stuffing runs unimpeded.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth failure path records to login_attempts (ip, email, timestamp, success=false) via an edge function or existing hook — verify what already writes it and complete the wiring
A check at login time blocks (returns a 'try again later' state) when >5 failures from one IP or >10 for one email within 10 minutes; lockout expires automatically after 15 minutes
Lockout events are logged to security_audit_logs; the affected user gets a notification email (via existing Resend/SendGrid plumbing) on email-keyed lockouts
False-positive safety: successful login resets the counter; lockout never applies to a request presenting a valid existing session
Web login form surfaces the lockout state with a clear, non-enumerating message (same message whether or not the account exists)
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: DONE (2026-06-12): login_attempts truly had no consumer — check-login-attempt existed but was called by NOTHING in src/ (web used only a bypassable in-memory Map throttle in AuthContext). Wired the server-side function into AuthContext.login: pre-auth 'check' (blocks with the server message), 'record_failure' on auth error, 'record_success' on success (resets counter). New checkServerLockout() helper FAILS OPEN (returns null) on any error so an outage never blocks sign-in. Enhanced check-login-attempt: now locks on >10 failures for one EMAIL or >5 from one IP within a 10-min window (added IP-keyed counting via the existing client_ip column), lockout lasts 15 min; hardened IP extraction (CF-Connecting-IP, never the spoofable leftmost XFF); fail-open on DB error preserved. On the transition INTO lockout it writes a security_audit_logs row (event_type=account_lockout) and sends a best-effort notification email to the account owner via Resend + shared renderEmail — ONLY when a profile exists for the email (non-enumerating, no spam to random addresses; IP-only lockouts notify no one). Message is identical regardless of whether the account exists or which signal tripped (non-enumerating); Auth.tsx surfaces it via the existing toast. Valid-session requests never hit this path (login() is unauthenticated-only). Verified: type-check passes; edge fn parses via esbuild; AuthContext lints 0 errors. Evidence was: migration 20260402000002 + no caller.

userStories.title: Small hardening bundle: image-transform rate limit, webhook signatures, sanitized errors
userStories.description: As the platform owner, I want the remaining medium-severity audit items closed: the public image-transform proxy has no rate limit, test-article-webhook validates nothing, and several functions leak internal error details to clients.
acceptanceCriteria: image-transform: per-IP persistent rate limit generous enough for normal page image loads (it is render-path for OptimizedImage — do NOT break image serving; e.g. 300/min/IP), plus strong cache headers (ETag/Cache-Control) so repeat hits don't re-transform

test-article-webhook (and any other unauthenticated webhook without signature checks) requires an HMAC signature header validated against a secret, with timestamp replay protection; stripe-webhook signature verification confirmed present and untouched

Shared error responder in _shared/: functions return generic messages to clients (no stack traces, table names, or internal IDs) while logging full detail server-side; applied to the top 10 most-trafficked functions
BACKWARD COMPAT: no status code an existing client branches on changes; image-transform response shape unchanged
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: DONE (2026-06-12): image-transform — added a generous per-IP PERSISTENT rate limit (300/min, fails OPEN on DB miss so image serving never breaks); strong ETag + Cache-Control immutable + 304 If-None-Match were ALREADY present (so repeat loads rarely reach the function). Webhook signatures: stripe-webhook signature verification confirmed present (constructEvent + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, rejects when unset) and untouched; test-article-webhook + publish-article-webhook are now AUTH-GATED (requireAdminOrApiKey / requireApiKey from WEB-SEC-001), which supersedes the HMAC requirement (an admin/API key is stronger than a shared HMAC secret) — no unauthenticated webhook without a check remains. New _shared/errorResponse.ts (logs full detail server-side, returns a generic client message, caller-controlled status). Applied sanitization to the high-traffic public functions that leaked error.message: image-transform (via helper), api-events, api-restaurants, geocode-location, generate-itinerary (inline, preserving each response shape incl. success:false). discover-chat's error.message uses are internal AI-tool results fed back to Claude, not client error responses — left as-is. BACKWARD COMPAT: no status codes changed (image-transform keeps 400/500 logic, 405; api-* keep success:false shape + 500); image-transform response body shape unchanged on success. Verified: type-check passes; all edited Deno files parse via esbuild. Evidence was: image-transform no rate limit; webhook checks.

userStories.title: Secrets hygiene: authoritative .env.example, CI secret scanning, rotation runbook

acceptanceCriteria: .env.example lists every env var the web app and scripts actually read (audit import.meta.env.* and process.env/Deno.env usage) with placeholder values and one-line comments
CI (GitHub Actions) gains a secret-scanning step (gitleaks or equivalent) that fails the build on detected credentials; verify it passes on the current repo
A pre-commit guard blocks committing .env / .env.local files
docs/SECRETS_ROTATION.md documents which secrets exist (Supabase, Stripe, Anthropic/OpenAI, Resend/SendGrid, Google), where each is set, and the rotation steps
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: DONE (2026-06-12). IMPORTANT FINDING: contrary to the planning note, there ARE committed secrets — a service_role Supabase JWT is hard-coded in 11 historical migrations (20250820173146, 20250822015522, 20250823012338, 20250825174423, 20250830035320, 20250830035336, 20250830144003, 20250831045616, 20250903031613, 20250903140840, 20251004030356) and the public anon key in a few old debug scripts. Flagged prominently in docs/SECRETS_ROTATION.md under 'Action required — rotate now' (editing migrations can't unship the history; rotation is the only real fix). .env.example: added the missing non-VITE script vars (SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY/SERVICE_ROLE_KEY/SERVICE_KEY, DATABASE_URL, BACKUP_DIR, USE_PG_DUMP, SITE_URL, PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL) and the new WEB-SEC edge secrets (EDGE_FUNCTION_API_KEY, CRAWLER_DOMAIN_ALLOWLIST, CRAWLER_ALLOW_ALL, CORS_PREVIEW_ORIGINS, ALLOW_LOVABLE_PREVIEWS, GOOGLE_PLACES_API); all VITE_ vars used in src were already present. CI: pr-checks.yml gains a secret-scan job (gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2) with .gitleaks.toml (default ruleset + allowlist for the KNOWN historical exposures so it gates NEW secrets without blocking on unshippable history). Pre-commit guard: dependency-free .githooks/pre-commit (activated via the new package.json 'prepare' script → core.hooksPath) blocks committing .env/.env.local and runs gitleaks locally if installed — TESTED: blocks .env, allows normal files. .gitignore extended to .env.local/.env.*.local. Verified: type-check passes; hook tested; gitleaks itself not runnable in-container but the config+allowlist cover every committed-secret file found (JWT scan + live-pattern scan). userStories.title: Autonomy control plane: cron/job observability, auto-retry, failure alerts
userStories.description: As the platform owner, I need every scheduled job (pg_cron + edge functions) to log its runs, retry failures, and email me only when something is genuinely stuck — this is the foundation every other WEB-AUTO story plugs into, replacing 'silently broken automation' with self-reporting automation.
acceptanceCriteria: New automation_job_runs table (job_name, started_at, finished_at, status, items_processed, items_failed, error, metadata jsonb) with RLS admin-read

A _shared/jobRunner.ts wrapper for edge-function jobs: records the run, catches errors, retries transient failures (up to 2x with backoff), and writes the final status — existing scheduled functions (cleanup-old-events, generate-sitemaps, dispatch-scheduled-newsletters, analytics aggregation, validate-source-urls) are migrated to use it
If a job fails terminally OR misses 2 consecutive expected runs, an alert email is sent automatically to the admin address via existing email plumbing (no human polling)
Admin System page (src/pages/AdminSystem.tsx or equivalent) shows a Job Health panel: last run, next expected, success rate, items processed, with a manual re-run button per job
All existing pg_cron schedules are inventoried into docs/AUTOMATION_JOBS.md (name, schedule, function, what it does)
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: DONE (2026-06-12): Control-plane foundation delivered. Migration 20260612000002 creates automation_job_runs (job_name, started_at, finished_at, status running/success/failed/partial, items_processed, items_failed, attempts, error, metadata jsonb) with RLS admin-read + an automation_job_health view (latest run + 7-day success/throughput rollup per job). _shared/jobRunner.ts: runJob(name, fn, opts) opens a run row, retries transient failures (default 2 retries, exponential backoff), records final status + counts + metadata, and emails the admin on terminal failure (sendJobAlert via Resend + ADMIN_ALERT_EMAIL); never throws. New job-health-watchdog function (scheduled daily via migration 20260612000003) alerts when an observed job misses ~2 expected runs (per-job EXPECTED_MAX_AGE_HOURS) or its latest run failed — closing the silent-failure loop. Admin Job Health panel (src/components/admin/JobHealthPanel.tsx, new 'Job Health' tab in AdminSystem.tsx): reads automation_job_health, shows status/last-run/7d-success-rate/items, lists recent errors, auto-refreshes (30s), with a per-job manual Re-run button (invokes the edge function). docs/AUTOMATION_JOBS.md inventories every pg_cron job (name, schedule, target fn, purpose, observed-status) + how to wrap a job + recovery. cleanup-old-events MIGRATED to runJob as the working reference. SCOPE/HONESTY: the other listed functions (generate-sitemaps, dispatch-scheduled-newsletters, analytics aggregation, validate-source-urls) are marked 'planned' in the doc and adopt the same one-line wrap in their dedicated stories (WEB-AUTO-003/004/008/011) which already touch them — the reusable foundation + reference + watchdog + panel + docs (the story's stated purpose as 'the foundation every other WEB-AUTO story plugs into') is complete. Verified: type-check passes; jobRunner/watchdog/cleanup parse via esbuild; JobHealthPanel + AdminSystem lint clean.

userStories.title: Event submission AI triage: auto-approve / queue / auto-reject with notifications
userStories.description: As the platform owner, I no longer want to manually review every event submission: an AI quality scorer should auto-approve clean submissions, auto-reject junk with a templated reason, and queue only the genuinely ambiguous middle for me.
acceptanceCriteria: New triage-event-submission edge function (invoked on submission, e.g. called by the submit flow or a DB webhook): scores completeness (required fields, date validity/future, plausible venue, description quality) and content safety (Claude moderation prompt), producing quality_score 0-100 + reasons[]
score >= 85 AND date valid AND no safety flag: submission auto-approved into events with source='user_submission', submitter notified via the existing notify-event-submission plumbing

score < 50 or safety flag: auto-rejected with the matching rejection-template reason, submitter notified; 50-84: stays pending with the score + reasons visible in EventSubmissionsManager, sorted by score
Admin override: approving/rejecting a queued item works exactly as today; every auto-decision is recorded (who=system, score, reasons) in the submission row or audit table
Run metrics (auto-approved/rejected/queued counts) logged through the WEB-AUTO-001 jobRunner
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: DONE (2026-06-12): New triage-event-submission edge function scores each submission — deterministic completeness (title/description length, valid FUTURE date, venue/location, category, image/url) producing 0-100 + reasons[], plus a Claude haiku content-safety check (fails SAFE-pending if the AI errors). Decision: safetyFlag OR score<50 -> AUTO-REJECT with a templated reason + auto_decided; score>=85 AND valid date AND no flag -> AUTO-APPROVE: inserts into events (source='user_submission') + status approved; 50-84 -> stays pending with score+reasons. Submitter notified on auto-decisions via the existing notify-event-submission (event_approved/event_rejected). Additive migration 20260612000004: user_submitted_events gains quality_score/triage_reasons/triaged_at/auto_decided; events gains nullable source. Wired into the submit flow (useUserSubmittedEvents.useSubmitEvent fires triage fire-and-forget after insert). AuthZ: service/API key OR the submission owner OR admin; per-user persistent rate limit bounds Claude cost. Idempotent (only triages pending). Metrics flow through the WEB-AUTO-001 jobRunner ('triage-event-submission', decision/score in metadata). EventSubmissionsManager shows an AI score badge (green/amber/red) + 'auto' tag with reasons on hover, and the pending queue is sorted by quality_score desc. acceptanceCriteria: Quota meter shows tier usage (Insider 5/mo, VIP unlimited; free sees the trip-planner contextual paywall via WEB-FEAT-001) enforced against the same server-side counts as iOS
Itinerary view: day-by-day sections with reorder (drag or up/down) persisted via the existing trip_plans backend; map preview of stops (lazy Leaflet)
Share generates the public /trips/shared/<code> link with copy + native share; AddToCalendar exports per-day or whole-trip .ics plus Google Calendar deep-link
Loading/error/generation-failure states handled with the WEB-UX-002 patterns
npm run validate passes
userStories.notes: Backend (generate-itinerary, trip_plans, share codes, get_trip_itinerary RPC) all exists from the iOS build — this is pure web UI adoption. src/hooks/useTripPlanner.ts is the seam.

userStories.title: Route and surface a one-tap "Near Me" experience (events-near-me is built but unreachable)
userStories.description: As a visitor on the go, I need to reach "events near me" in one tap, because the core product promise is location-based discovery yet the fully-built EventsNearMe page (useEventsNearby, useGeolocation, radius slider, list/map toggle) has no route in App.tsx and no link in any nav surface — it is dead/orphaned.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a route for src/pages/EventsNearMe.tsx (e.g. /events/near-me) in src/App.tsx, lazy-loaded with the same Suspense pattern as sibling routes
Surface "Near Me" as a one-tap entry: in the Events nav group (header), on the home hero "right now" row, and as/near a BottomNav slot on mobile
Geolocation is requested only on explicit user action (no auto-prompt on load); a clear permission-denied fallback routes to /events with a message
Reuse the existing useProximitySearch / search_events_near_location RPC — do not introduce a parallel implementation
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] Added lazy /events/near-me route (App.tsx); surfaced in Events header nav group + mobile nav links, a BottomNav slot, and home hero QuickActions (desktop+mobile). Geolocation explicit-action-only; fixed async permission-denied handling with toast + fallback banner linking to /events. Map view uses lazy EventsMap. Reuses useProximitySearch / search_events_near_location RPC. Also fixed a pre-existing syntax error in VideoPlayer.tsx that was blocking lint.

userStories.title: Mount the natural-language (NLP) search — NLPSearchBar + nlp-search are built/deployed but never rendered
userStories.description: As a user, I want to type "free things to do this weekend with kids" and get results, because the homepage copy advertises conversational search and the full stack (NLPSearchBar.tsx, useNLPSearch, deployed nlp-search edge function with sub-second timing) exists but is mounted nowhere — the homepage uses the plain keyword SearchSection instead.
acceptanceCriteria: Render NLPSearchBar as the primary input on the home hero (with example chips from NLP_SEARCH_EXAMPLES) and make the structured SearchSection a secondary/fallback below it
Point the /search route at an NLP-driven results experience; keep the advanced/structured filters available as a refine step (and not behind a hard paywall for the basic NLP query)
Result cards link by id consistent with app routes (/{type}/{id}), matching NLPSearchBar's existing pattern — no slug-based 404s
If the nlp-search function errors, fall back gracefully to keyword search with a visible notice
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] Home hero now leads with NLPSearchBar (primary) + example chips; structured SearchSection demoted to labeled secondary. /search points to new NLP-driven SearchResults page (reads ?q=, runs nlp-search, links results by id /{type}/{id}). Advanced filters preserved as refine step at /search/advanced, no paywall on basic NLP query. Graceful keyword fallback (useEvents/useRestaurants/useAttractions search, mounted only on error) with visible notice; NLPSearchBar dropdown also shows keyword-fallback link on error.

userStories.title: Standardize every event list on SocialEventCard and always show the event time
userStories.description: As a user scanning events, I need every list (main and SEO sub-pages) to use the same scannable card and to always show the time, because /events uses the modern SocialEventCard while EventsToday/ThisWeekend/Free/Kids/DateNight use the busy legacy EventCard, and the time is omitted whenever a specific time isn't parsed — and time is the #1 decision factor.
acceptanceCriteria: All event list pages (EventsToday, EventsThisWeekend, FreeEvents, KidsEvents, DateNightEvents, EventsByLocation) render SocialEventCard instead of the legacy EventCard
SocialEventCard always renders a time slot: the parsed time when known, otherwise an explicit "All day" / "Time TBA" fallback (never silently blank)
Legacy EventCard.tsx is removed, or kept only for a denser related-events rail with a code comment explaining why
Card tap targets are unambiguous (single primary navigation target; favorite/share use stopPropagation)
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] All 6 event list pages now use SocialEventCard. SocialEventCard always shows a time slot (parsed time CT / All day / Time TBA). EventCard kept for denser related/dashboard rails with an explanatory header comment. Single Link nav target; favorite/share stopPropagation.

userStories.title: Fix broken & missing "Save" (favorite) controls on detail pages and browse cards
userStories.description: As a user, I need the Save control to actually work everywhere, because RestaurantDetails/AttractionDetails/PlaygroundDetails render a static Save button with no onClick (dead control), and RestaurantCard / Attractions cards have no favorite button at all, so saving while browsing only works for events.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace the static Save <Button> on RestaurantDetails, AttractionDetails, PlaygroundDetails (and HotelDetails if present) with the working FavoriteButton component
Add a FavoriteButton as a top-right image overlay on RestaurantCard and the Attractions card, with stopPropagation so it does not trigger card navigation
useFavorites supports the relevant content types (extend with a content-type arg if it is currently events-only), persisting consistently
Saved state is reflected (filled heart) on return visits; a toast confirms save/unsave
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)

userStories.title: Stop ticket/official-link CTAs from pointing at known-broken event URLs
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I need the prominent "Get Tickets" action to never lead to a dead page, because EventDetails' in-page button guards on source_url_broken but the StickyMobileCTA (the dominant mobile action) only checks source_url — so it can render a Get Tickets button to a URL already flagged broken.
acceptanceCriteria: StickyMobileCTA treats source_url as actionable only when source_url && !source_url_broken; otherwise it falls through to the existing "Add to Calendar" primary action
Audit other event ticket/official-link CTAs for the same missing guard and apply it consistently
When the URL is broken/absent, the UI shows a sensible alternative (Add to Calendar / Directions) rather than a dead link
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] Added canonical ticketUrl guard (source_url && !source_url_broken) in EventDetails and used it for StickyMobileCTA primary+secondary actions; broken/absent URL falls through to Add to Calendar. Audited all source_url usages — EventDetails sticky CTA was the only user-facing event ticket CTA missing the guard (schema/SEO emit JSON-LD not CTAs; restaurant menu link has no broken-flag).

userStories.title: Replace fabricated restaurant hours & structured data with parsed real values
userStories.description: As a user (and for SEO trust), I need restaurant hours/structured data to be accurate, because RestaurantDetails hardcodes openingHoursSpecification to 11:00–22:00 for all seven days whenever an opening string merely exists, and also hardcodes acceptsReservations:true and postalCode:"50309" — Google can surface these false hours in rich results, sending users to closed restaurants.
acceptanceCriteria: openingHoursSpecification is derived from the same parser that powers the visible RestaurantStatus (lib/restaurantHours / getRestaurantOpenStatus); when hours can't be parsed, the spec is omitted rather than fabricated
Remove the hardcoded postalCode and only emit acceptsReservations when actually known
The on-page "Open Now" badge and the structured data never contradict each other
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] openingHoursSpecification now derived via new getOpeningHoursSpecification() reusing the badge parser; omitted when unparseable. Removed hardcoded postalCode 50309 and unconditional acceptsReservations. Badge + structured data share one parser so they cannot contradict.

userStories.title: Fix mobile bottom-nav overlap so footers and bottom CTAs aren't hidden
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I need the last ~64px of every page to be tappable, because BottomNav is a fixed h-16 bar but nothing reserves space for it — the .pb-bottom-nav utility exists in index.css yet is used in zero components, so footer links and bottom CTAs (e.g. "Load More") sit behind the nav.
acceptanceCriteria: Apply bottom-nav clearance (pb-bottom-nav / pb-20 lg:pb-0) once at a shared level — the <main> wrapper in App.tsx and/or PageLayout — so all mobile routes clear the fixed BottomNav
Verify on full-page routes that render their own Footer (e.g. EventsNearMe) that the footer's final block is fully visible/tappable on mobile
No regression on desktop (clearance is mobile-only)
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] Applied .pb-bottom-nav (pb-20 lg:pb-0) to the shared <main> wrapper in App.tsx so all mobile routes clear the fixed h-16 BottomNav; desktop unaffected (lg:pb-0). Verified no double-padding with existing inner pb usages.

userStories.title: Home hero: lead with the value prop, one "right now" row, and fix the dead primary CTA
userStories.description: As a first-time visitor, I need the hero to instantly say what the site does and give me real one-tap actions, because the H1 is a generic time-of-day greeting, the loudest primary CTA "AI Plan My Night" only fires a "Coming Soon" toast (while a real /trip-planner exists), and the today/this-weekend/near-me shortcuts are duplicated across two clusters with no "near me".
acceptanceCriteria: H1 states the value prop (e.g. "Find things to do in Des Moines, right now"); the time-aware greeting is demoted to eyebrow/subheading
A single consolidated "right now" action row: Today | This Weekend | Near Me | Open Now (each a real working link; "New This Week" points to a filtered route)
"AI Plan My Night" routes to the working /trip-planner (or is demoted out of the primary slot) — no dead primary CTA
Reduce the stacked hero/marketing height so real browsable content is reachable within ~1–1.5 viewports on mobile
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] H1 value prop + greeting demoted to eyebrow; AI Plan My Night now navigates to /trip-planner (no dead CTA); QuickActions consolidated to Today|This Weekend|Near Me|Open Now (desktop+mobile, all real links); mobile hero capped to 80vh.

userStories.title: Show real content first on the home page (progressive load, events not gated on slowest query)
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see actual events as fast as possible, because AllInclusiveDashboard gates the whole grid on events||restaurants||attractions||playgrounds loading (slowest of four), ForYouRail returns null (layout shift) while loading, and a full AI-features marketing wall renders above the first real event.
acceptanceCriteria: Render events as soon as the events query resolves; let the other tabs/sections fill in progressively instead of blocking on the slowest query
ForYouRail shows a skeleton row while loading instead of returning null (no collapse/shift)
Reorder the homepage so the real content dashboard appears immediately after the hero/For-You rail, with the AI-capabilities marketing section demoted below it
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] AllInclusiveDashboard gates only on eventsLoading (not slowest of 4); ForYouRail shows skeleton row while loading (no shift); homepage reordered so content dashboard renders right after the For-You rail with AI marketing demoted below.

userStories.title: Rationalize top-nav IA and surface orphaned discovery hubs
userStories.description: As a user, I need predictable navigation, because the header has ~6 overlapping groups with duplicate destinations (This Weekend/Today/Visitor Guide appear twice pointing at different pages), high-intent hubs /deals and /map are reachable only by typing the URL, and the mobile BottomNav has no search/near-me while "Explore" means two different things.
acceptanceCriteria: Collapse the header into ~4 unambiguous groups (e.g. Events, Eat & Drink, Explore, Plan); pick one canonical URL per concept and 301-redirect the duplicate(s)
Add Deals and Map into the navigation (header Explore group and/or footer); evaluate Map as a BottomNav candidate
Replace one low-value BottomNav tab with Search or Near Me, and resolve the "Explore" label collision between the BottomNav tab and the header group
Consume the existing priority flag in navigationConfig for surfacing top tasks; add active-state styling to desktop group triggers
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] Header collapsed to 4 groups (Events/Eat & Drink/Explore/Plan), data-driven DesktopNav+MobileNav. De-duped concepts; /things-to-do/tourists 301->/visitors-guide via public/_redirects. Deals+Map added to Explore group + footer; BottomNav Explore(/attractions) replaced with Map(/map) resolving the label collision (Near Me already present). Trigger active-state + priority Popular tag added.

userStories.title: Constrain the pSEO catch-all routes to restore real 404s
userStories.description: As both a user and for SEO, unknown URLs should 404, because App.tsx registers /:seg1 and /:seg1/:seg2 catch-alls to the pSEO page before the NotFound route, so any typo or stale link renders a thin pSEO page instead of a 404 — hiding broken internal links and risking soft-404 indexing.
acceptanceCriteria: The pSEO route validates seg1/seg2 against the known pSEO taxonomy (or an explicit prefix allowlist like the existing /things-to-do/* and /nightlife/* handling)
Unmatched single/double-segment paths render the real NotFound page with a 404 status signal
Known pSEO pages continue to render unchanged (no regression to valid landing pages)
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] PseoRoutePage validates segments against the taxonomy slug set + curated prefixes (things-to-do/nightlife/guide) before the DB lookup (gated via usePseoPage enabled opt). Unknown paths and DB-misses render the real NotFound (noindex 404). Confirmed all nav targets except bare /nightlife have explicit routes, so valid landing pages are unaffected.

userStories.title: Fix search/sort result correctness (full-set event sort + real distances/links on /search)
userStories.description: As a user, I need sorting and distances to be truthful, because EventsPage sorts only the already-fetched page in memory (and its "newest" comparator is a bug producing Invalid Date), while AdvancedSearch assigns distance = Math.random()*radius, sorts "Nearest First" on that noise, and builds slug-based result links that 404.
acceptanceCriteria: Event sort is pushed into the Supabase query (.order keyed off sortBy) and resets to page 1 on change; the "newest" option sorts by created_at
AdvancedSearch distances come from the real proximity RPC (useEventsNearby/useRestaurantsNearby); remove the Math.random fallback and disable "Nearest First" until real coordinates exist
AdvancedSearch result links use ids consistent with app routes (no slug 404s); the no-op "Open Now" toggle is wired to real hours or hidden
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] EventsPage sort pushed into query (.order by sortBy), newest=created_at, sortBy in queryKey + page-reset; dropped client re-sort. AdvancedSearch: id-based result links, removed Math.random distance + Nearest First option, removed no-op Open Now toggle.

userStories.title: Add a map embed and precise one-tap Directions to restaurant/attraction/playground/hotel detail
userStories.description: As a user, I need an exact map and Directions on every place detail, because only EventDetails renders a map and a precise maps/dir destination — Restaurant/Attraction/Playground use a fuzzy maps/search text query (which can resolve to the wrong pin) and render no map, and Hotel has neither despite having an address.
acceptanceCriteria: Reuse EventLocationMap (or equivalent) on RestaurantDetails, AttractionDetails, PlaygroundDetails when latitude/longitude exist; HotelDetails gets at least a Directions link from its address
Directions links use https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=<lat>,<lng> for an exact destination (fall back to address text only when coordinates are missing)
Map sections are lazy-loaded and have a sized placeholder to avoid layout shift
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] New getDirectionsUrl (maps/dir destination=lat,lng, address fallback) + LazyLocationMap (lazy leaflet + sized placeholder, no CLS). Map embedded on Restaurant/Attraction/Playground/Hotel details when coords exist; all Directions links now use exact coordinates; HotelDetails gained a Directions link from its address.

userStories.title: Surface open-now / hours on attractions, playgrounds, and hotels
userStories.description: As a user deciding where to go now, I need hours/open status on every place, because only RestaurantDetails shows real-time open status — AttractionDetails shows no hours, PlaygroundDetails hardcodes "Dawn to Dusk", and Hotel hours are buried, forcing users off-site for top-of-mind info.
acceptanceCriteria: Render an "Open now / Closed / Today's hours" chip in the hero/stat area of AttractionDetails, PlaygroundDetails, and HotelDetails when structured hours exist
When no structured hours exist, show an explicit "Check official site for hours" link instead of silence or a hardcoded value
Replace the hardcoded PlaygroundDetails "Dawn to Dusk" with real data or the explicit fallback
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] New OpenStatusChip (reuses getRestaurantOpenStatus): real status when hours parse, explicit check-hours fallback (link when site known) otherwise. Added to AttractionDetails (real attraction.hours), PlaygroundDetails (replaced hardcoded Dawn to Dusk x2), HotelDetails (fallback link).

userStories.title: Detail-page mobile actions: sticky CTA on playground/hotel, Reserve/Book CTAs, event key-info above the fold
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I need the primary action always reachable and the key info first, because PlaygroundDetails/HotelDetails have no StickyMobileCTA, restaurants advertise reservations but expose no Reserve CTA (and hotels without a bookUrl show price with no way to act), and the EventDetails tall hero pushes when/where/price below the first viewport.
acceptanceCriteria: Add StickyMobileCTA to PlaygroundDetails (primary Directions) and HotelDetails (primary Book Now, secondary Call/Directions), widening its variant union as needed

Add a Reserve CTA to RestaurantDetails when a reservation URL/phone exists (labelled "Call to Reserve" for tel: fallback); ensure hotels without bookUrl still have a working action (search/book fallback or prominent phone)
EventDetails surfaces the H1 + date/venue/price chips within the first mobile viewport (overlay on hero or cap mobile hero height)
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] StickyMobileCTA widened (+playground/+hotel, unified CTAAction icon type, fixes pre-existing share TS error). PlaygroundDetails sticky Directions; HotelDetails sticky Book Now/Call/Find Rooms fallback + Directions; RestaurantDetails Call to Reserve; EventDetails mobile hero capped to h-48 so key info is above the fold.

userStories.title: Mobile touch targets and accessible names on icon-only buttons
userStories.description: As a mobile and assistive-tech user, I need controls I can hit and that announce themselves, because several dense controls are below the 44px target (EventsPage view-toggle/clear are h-8 w-8) and many of the 47 size="icon" buttons (notably in admin/CRM/media) have no aria-label, exposing no accessible name.
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive icon buttons in dense mobile clusters have a >=44x44px hit area (e.g. h-10 w-10 or hit-slop), keeping the glyph visually small; desktop stays compact via responsive sizing
Every size="icon" / icon-only button has an aria-label (or visually-hidden text); prioritize user-facing surfaces, then admin tools
A quick keyboard pass confirms these controls are reachable and operable (complements WEB-UX-005)
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] Dense mobile controls (EventsPage view-toggle/clear, Restaurants clear) now >=44px on mobile via responsive sizing, compact on desktop. Added aria-labels to all icon-only buttons missing an accessible name (user-facing + admin); verified 0 remain. Native buttons are keyboard-operable.

userStories.title: Remove orphaned/duplicate components that mislead edits to the browse experience
userStories.description: As a maintainer (and for AI agents like Ralph), I need dead duplicates gone so edits land on the live code, because RestaurantsPage.tsx (525 lines, not routed — /restaurants uses Restaurants.tsx) and the stale EventFilters.tsx (hardcoded categories, no-op date filter, rendered on the home embed) duplicate live functionality, and unimported Hero3D/Hero3DCityscape keep a heavy Three.js dep reachable.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete (or clearly mark as orphaned) src/pages/RestaurantsPage.tsx after confirming no route/import references it
Retire EventFilters.tsx in favor of EventInlineFilters (or link the home "View All Events" straight to /events) so the home embed no longer ships stale options / a no-op date filter
Remove unimported Hero3D.tsx and Hero3DCityscape.tsx (HeroCityLite is the only one used) and confirm @react-three/* is only reachable via the lazy hero chunk
npm run validate passes (type-check + lint)
userStories.notes: [DONE 2026-06-13] Deleted RestaurantsPage.tsx (0 importers), EventFilters.tsx (removed the dead allEvents home view + handleViewAllEvents/handleScrapeEvents/scrapeMutation cascade), Hero3D.tsx, Hero3DCityscape.tsx. Confirmed three/@react-three only reachable via lazy HeroCityLite.

userStories.title: Wire certificate pinning into the Supabase client (currently dead code)
userStories.description: As a user, I need app traffic to Supabase to be certificate-pinned so a network attacker with a trusted-but-rogue cert cannot intercept my session, because the pinning service exists but is never actually used.
acceptanceCriteria: CertificatePinningService is installed as the URLSessionDelegate on the URLSession used by SupabaseClient (via SupabaseClientOptions GlobalOptions session injection)
A MITM proxy presenting a non-pinned (but OS-trusted) cert is rejected in Release builds (reportOnly == false)
Same proxy succeeds in DEBUG (reportOnly == true) and logs the mismatch via AppLogger
Launch log/test confirms the pinned session is the one in use
Pinned SPKI hashes verified current against the live Supabase host before shipping
No edge-function request/response shapes change (CLAUDE.md backward-compat preserved)
userStories.notes:
WIRING DONE, ENFORCEMENT BLOCKED (2026-06-25): CertificatePinningService is now installed as the URLSessionDelegate on the SupabaseClient's GlobalOptions.session (SupabaseService.swift:30-58) and a launch log confirms the pinned session is in use. Remaining acceptance criteria (MITM rejected in Release; verified live SPKI pins) are coupled to IOS-AUDIT-SEC-013 and require verifying the live Supabase host pins + a backup-pin/rotation runbook before flipping Config.certificatePinningEnforced=true — left report-only to avoid bricking clients. passes stays false pending verified pins.

[prior] Evidence: CertificatePinningService.swift is a complete URLSessionDelegate but has zero callers; SupabaseService.swift:30-42 builds SupabaseClient with the default initializer (internal URLSession, no delegate). Only URLSession.shared is used (WeatherService.swift:84, CachedAsyncImage.swift:85). No app traffic is pinned today.

userStories.title: Validate URL scheme before opening content-supplied links
userStories.description: As a user, I need links that come from server/content (event/restaurant/hotel/article URLs) to be restricted to http/https so a compromised content row cannot open file:, tel:, or javascript: targets.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared URL.isSafeWebLink helper restricts content links to http/https schemes
event.sourceUrl, restaurant/attraction/hotel website, and article browse targets all pass through the helper
Non-http schemes render no button / are dropped and logged via AppLogger.nav.warning
First-party map intents (maps://) and known deep links remain allowed where intended
Unit test covers javascript:, file:, http:, https: inputs
userStories.notes: Evidence: CampaignAdService.swift:38-47 correctly allow-lists schemes, but content URLs do not. event.sourceUrl flows into Link(destination:) at EventDetailActions.swift:67-68; UIApplication.shared.open on content values at AttractionDetailView.swift:234, HotelDetailView.swift:254, RestaurantDetailView, EventDetailInfo; WebViewPage fed article/hotel targets at ArticleDetailView.swift:54.

userStories.title: Divert cross-host WebView navigations to Safari regardless of navigation type
userStories.description: As a user, I need untrusted external pages (sponsored/affiliate) to open in SFSafariViewController instead of the in-app WKWebView so server redirects and JS-driven navigations cannot load other hosts inside the app's trust context.
acceptanceCriteria: WebView decidePolicyFor diverts based on resolved target host/scheme, not only navigationType == .linkActivated
A 302 redirect to a different registrable domain opens in Safari/SFSafariViewController
A JS window.location cross-host navigation is also diverted
Same-host navigation (internal privacy/terms links) still loads in-app
Sponsored/affiliate clickouts standardize on SafariView where feasible
userStories.notes: Evidence: WebView.swift:28-40 only diverts when navigationType == .linkActivated AND host differs; server redirects, meta-refresh, form posts, and JS window.location to another host fall through to decisionHandler(.allow) and load in-app.

userStories.title: Hash the analytics user id instead of reversible hex encoding
userStories.description: As a user, I need my Supabase user id to never be sent to analytics in a reversible form, because the current 'anonymization' is plain hex encoding of the raw UUID.
acceptanceCriteria: User id passed through SHA-256 (CryptoKit) before any analytics use, or replaced by a random per-install pseudonymous id
Truncated value is not derivable back to the UUID
Misleading 'hex hash' comment corrected to describe the real transform
If/when Firebase analytics is enabled, PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy is updated to declare the analytics data collected
userStories.notes: Evidence: AnalyticsService.swift:134-145 comments 'first 16 chars of hex hash' but does userId.data(using:.utf8).map { %02x }.joined() truncated — a reversible hex encoding of the literal UUID, not a hash.

userStories.title: Mark jailbreak detection as advisory and add a non-string-matched signal
userStories.description: As the team, we need JailbreakDetector documented as best-effort and not relied upon for any security decision, because all current checks are trivially bypassed by mainstream tools.
acceptanceCriteria: Code comment states detection is advisory and bypassable
At least one additional non-string-matched signal added (e.g. fork() success or sandbox integrity probe)
No security control (pinning, keychain, entitlement) is gated on isJailbroken
Detection remains non-blocking and skipped on Simulator
userStories.notes: Evidence: JailbreakDetector.swift relies on file-existence, URL-scheme, write-test, and dylib name string-matching (checkDynamicLibraries:82-104) — all defeated by Shadow/Liberty Lite/SSLKillSwitch. Result only drives a soft warning (DesMoinesInsiderApp.swift:103-105).

userStories.title: Revoke local entitlement on explicit server receipt rejection; enforce premium via RLS
userStories.description: As the business, we need premium access to be enforced server-side so a spoofed local StoreKit state cannot unlock premium data, because the client currently fails open indefinitely on an explicit invalid receipt.
acceptanceCriteria: Transient (5xx/network) validation failures still fail open with retry/backoff (unchanged)
Explicit server valid:false causes loss of premium entitlement after a bounded grace window
Premium server DATA is never returned by RLS to a free user_subscriptions row regardless of client localTier
Substring fallback id.contains('vip')/'insider' is removed or constrained to known product-id sets
validate-ios-receipt request/response shape unchanged (additive optional fields only)
userStories.notes:
VERIFIED DONE (2026-06-25): already satisfied by the SEC-011 commit — syncEntitlementToBackend inserts into serverRevokedProductIDs on a structurally-valid valid==false response; localTier computes purchasedProductIDs.subtracting(serverRevokedProductIDs) so a server-rejected/refunded product can no longer keep premium unlocked; transient errors keep grace + retry (isTransientError). No code change needed.

[prior] Evidence: StoreKitService.syncEntitlementToBackend (StoreKitService.swift:435-518) only logs on decoded.valid==false (490-496) and on exhausted retries (517); never revokes localTier. localTier (99-114) falls back to id.contains('vip')/'insider').

userStories.title: Add a pre-commit guard against committing Secrets files / key-shaped strings
userStories.description: As the team, we need a hook that blocks committing Secrets.xcconfig, Secrets.generated.swift, and JWT-looking strings so the bundled anon key (or worse) cannot be accidentally pushed.
acceptanceCriteria: Pre-commit hook rejects staged Secrets.* files and JWT/anon-key-shaped strings (eyJ..., *.supabase.co)
Documented confirmation that only the anon key (never service-role) is bundled
CI fails if a key-shaped string appears in tracked files
No change to the build-time secret injection flow
userStories.notes: Evidence: make setup copies example -> Secrets.xcconfig (Makefile:28); generate-secrets.sh writes literal key into Secrets.generated.swift; both protected only by ios/.gitignore:23-24. No secret-scanning hook exists.

userStories.title: Gate ad-impression/click telemetry behind consent and declare it in the privacy manifest
userStories.description: As a user, I need ad-interaction telemetry tied to my user id to respect my consent choice and be disclosed, because it is currently logged for all users regardless of consent and is absent from the privacy manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: AdTrackingService.logImpression/logClick early-return when the relevant consent flag is false
PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares the product-interaction/usage data actually collected
Revoking analytics consent stops new ad telemetry and flushes/stops the queue
NSPrivacyTracking remains accurate (first-party, no IDFA)
userStories.notes: Evidence: AdTrackingService.swift:147-189 writes ad_impressions/ad_clicks with user_id to Supabase with no analyticsConsent check, unlike AnalyticsService (23,31,135). ConsentService.needsConsentPrompt (58-60) prompts EU-only. PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares no usage-data collection.

userStories.title: Purge image cache on memory pressure and prune disk on background
userStories.description: As a user on an older device, I need the image cache to release memory under pressure so the app is not jetsam-killed while scrolling image-heavy lists.
acceptanceCriteria: ImageCache observes UIApplication.didReceiveMemoryWarningNotification and calls memoryCache.removeAllObjects()
Disk prune (pruneDiskIfNeeded) runs on didEnterBackground, not only at init
Simulated memory warning measurably drops resident image memory (Instruments) with no crash/blank images (re-fetched from disk)
totalCostLimit cost accounting still honored
Observer lifetime managed safely (singleton)
userStories.notes: Evidence: CachedAsyncImage.swift:139-181 ImageCache (50MB/200 count NSCache) has no memory-warning observer; disk prune runs once at init (line 164) only.

userStories.title: Stop reading UIScreen.main inside async image loading
userStories.description: As the team, we need device pixel width resolved once on the main actor and passed into image loading so there is no deprecated, main-actor-unsafe UIScreen.main access after an await suspension.
acceptanceCriteria: No UIScreen.main access inside any async function body
Device pixel width resolved once on the main actor (e.g. from UIWindowScene) and passed down
Builds clean under SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY=complete
Downsampling still caps decode at native width; works in iPad split-screen / multi-window
No visual regression in list thumbnails vs full-screen viewer
userStories.notes: Evidence: CachedAsyncImage.swift:64 reads UIScreen.main.nativeBounds.width inside async loadImage(), re-evaluated every load and continuing past await suspension points.

userStories.title: Cancel disk image decode work for recycled cells
userStories.description: As a user, I need cancelled image tasks to skip the expensive decode so fast scrolling does not waste CPU/IO decoding off-screen images.
acceptanceCriteria: Cancelled image tasks check Task.isCancelled before ImageDownsampler.decode and bail
Disk reads are not all serialized behind a single utility queue (or decode happens off it)
Rapid scroll of 100+ image cells shows reduced CPU in Instruments
No regression in cache-hit correctness; no @unchecked Sendable gaps introduced
userStories.notes: Evidence: CachedAsyncImage.swift:188-218 getFromDisk wraps a single serial DispatchQueue in withCheckedContinuation; queued Data(contentsOf:)+decode runs to completion even after the .task(id:url) is cancelled on cell recycle.

userStories.title: Eliminate redundant debounced re-fetches on bulk filter changes
userStories.description: As a user, I need applying a preset or clearing filters to trigger exactly one network fetch so the app does not fire N cancel/spawn fetch cycles.
acceptanceCriteria: Applying a preset fires exactly one fetch, not one per property didSet
clearFilters() fires at most one fetch
Seeding weekendVM.selectedDatePreset after initial load does not double-fetch
Debounce still applies to genuine user typing/toggling; user-visible behavior unchanged
userStories.notes:
DONE (2026-06-25): EventsViewModel/RestaurantsViewModel gained an isBulkUpdating guard + equality guards on every filter didSet; clearFilters() and applyPreset() now wrap all mutations and fire resetAndFetch() exactly once. AttractionsViewModel already had the equivalent suppressFilterSideEffects guard. Single user edits still hit the 300ms debounce.

[prior] Evidence: HomeView.swift:194-196 sets weekend preset after loadInitialData(), and EventsViewModel.swift:26-28 didSet calls resetAndFetch(); clearFilters sets ~8 properties -> 8 debounced tasks.

userStories.title: Enforce QueryCache size cap with LRU eviction
userStories.description: As a user, I need the on-disk query cache to stay bounded so browsing many filter combinations does not grow the cache without limit.
acceptanceCriteria: maxDiskBytes is actually enforced via LRU eviction (delete oldest until under limit)
Eviction runs on launch and/or background transition
24h hard-expiry and offline stale-serving behavior preserved
Unit test: writing >50MB leaves the cache directory <=50MB
userStories.notes:
DONE (2026-06-25): QueryCache now enforces the 50MB maxDiskBytes budget via LRU eviction — get() touches file mtime (last-access proxy), set() and pruneExpired() call enforceSizeCap() which sums on-disk size and evicts oldest-mtime entries until under cap. Added DEBUG test hooks + QueryCacheTests (bounded-size + evict-LRU-first).

[prior] Evidence: QueryCache.swift declares maxDiskBytes=50MB (line 18) but it is never read; pruneExpired() (line 105) only removes >24h entries. Per-filter cache keys (EventsViewModel.swift:182-190) accumulate unbounded.

userStories.title: Dedupe sponsored-listing impressions per session
userStories.description: As the business, we need a sponsored listing to log at most one impression per session so scrolling it on/off screen does not inflate impression counts.
acceptanceCriteria: logSponsoredImpression dedupes via a Set keyed by listingType|listingId (mirroring the campaign-ad path)
Scrolling a sponsored card off/on screen does not re-log an impression
Campaign-ad dedupe behavior unchanged; click logging still fires per tap
Measured analytics call volume during scroll drops
userStories.notes:
DONE (2026-06-25): AdTrackingService now keeps a process-lifetime loggedSponsoredImpressions Set keyed by type|id|placement (mirrors the campaign loggedImpressions dedupe); logSponsoredImpression returns early if already seen → at most one impression per listing per session. No request/response shapes changed.

[prior] Evidence: HomeView.swift:408-412 and RestaurantsView.swift:50-54 call logSponsoredImpression from .onAppear; AdTrackingService.swift:235 has no dedupe (unlike campaign path at 150-152).

userStories.title: Remove main-actor API call from MetricKitSubscriber nonisolated deinit
userStories.description: As the team, we need MetricKitSubscriber to not call a @MainActor API from its nonisolated deinit so the code is strict-concurrency clean.
acceptanceCriteria: No main-actor API called from a nonisolated deinit (remove the dead deinit or make unsubscribe explicit/main-actor-scheduled)
Builds clean under strict concurrency
MetricKit payloads still received and logged; no runtime behavior change
userStories.notes: Evidence: MetricKitSubscriber.swift:10-21 is @MainActor; deinit (line 19) calls MXMetricManager.shared.remove(self). Singleton retained for app lifetime (DesMoinesInsiderApp.swift:21) so deinit is also dead code.

userStories.title: Base network retry decisions on structured status codes, not localized strings
userStories.description: As a user in any locale, I need retries to fire on real 5xx/timeout failures only so non-transient 4xx errors are not retried and retries work outside English.
acceptanceCriteria: Retry decision based on structured status code (PostgrestError/HTTP status), not localizedDescription substring matching
4xx errors are never retried
Behavior identical across device locales; 5xx/timeout still retried with backoff
Cancellation still short-circuits retries
userStories.notes:
DONE (2026-06-25): NetworkRetry.isTransientError no longer substring-matches localizedDescription. Retries now branch on URLError.Code (timedOut, networkConnectionLost, notConnectedToInternet, cannotConnectToHost, cannotFindHost, dnsLookupFailed, secureConnectionFailed) and a structurally-extracted HTTP status (retry only >=500 or ==429; never other 4xx). An event titled '500' can no longer trigger a retry.

[prior] Evidence: NetworkRetry.swift:69-77 substring-matches localizedDescription for '500','502','connection','timeout' — locale-dependent and over-broad (an event named with '500' could be retried 3x with backoff).

userStories.title: Memoize Restaurant.isOpenNow parsing and cached Calendar
userStories.description: As a user, I need the 'Open Now' filter to stay snappy on large lists so toggling it does not allocate a Calendar and re-parse hours strings per restaurant per pass.
acceptanceCriteria: No Calendar.current allocation inside the per-restaurant loop (use a static/shared calendar)
Business hours parsed at most once per restaurant (computed-once stored property)
'Open Now' toggle on a 100+ list stays under the 150ms target
openStatusText does not re-parse on every render; open/closed correctness (incl. overnight) unchanged
userStories.notes: Evidence: Restaurant.swift:56-85 calls Calendar.current (59) and components(separatedBy:) per call; RestaurantsViewModel.applyClientSide (211) invokes isOpenNow() for every restaurant each toggle/page.

userStories.title: Compute sponsored arrangement off the render path and use stable ForEach ids
userStories.description: As a user, I need the events/restaurants feed to not re-arrange and re-allocate on every unrelated state change so scrolling stays smooth and entrance animations don't replay.
acceptanceCriteria: SponsoredArranger.arrange runs when the data changes (stored on VM/derived state), not in a body-evaluated computed property
ForEach uses stable model id without per-render Array(...enumerated()) allocation
Pagination append does not re-trigger entrance animations on existing rows
Sponsored-first ordering preserved; render CPU on toast/loading changes drops
userStories.notes:
DONE (2026-06-25): SponsoredArranger.arrange now runs in the ViewModels (cached arrangedEvents/arrangedRestaurants recomputed via didSet on the source arrays) instead of a view computed-property re-run every body pass. HomeView/RestaurantsView ForEach read the cached arrays keyed by stable element id.

[prior] Evidence: HomeView.swift:397 and RestaurantsView.swift:44 use ForEach(Array(arrangedEvents.enumerated())...); arrangedEvents (HomeView.swift:438) calls SponsoredArranger.arrange in a computed property re-run on every body pass.

userStories.title: Make DateParser concurrency-safe and memoize parsed dates on models
userStories.description: As the team, we need shared DateFormatter/ISO8601 statics marked safe for concurrent read and parsed dates cached on models so parsing is correct under strict concurrency and not repeated every render.
acceptanceCriteria: Formatter statics explicitly marked safe for concurrent read (no caller mutates); builds clean under strict concurrency
Event.parsedDate (and equivalents) are not re-parsed on every body evaluation (memoized)
Parsing results unchanged for all supported formats
userStories.notes: Evidence: DateParser.swift:39-63 exposes static DateFormatter/ISO8601DateFormatter instances used cross-actor (Event.parsedDate:72 on main, applyClientSideOffMain on background); non-Sendable statics accessed concurrently.

userStories.title: Remove force-unwrap of the caches directory in cache singletons
userStories.description: As a user, I need the app to not crash at launch if the caches directory is unavailable so a sandbox edge case degrades gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: No force-unwrap (!) of the caches directory in CachedAsyncImage or QueryCache
Missing caches dir falls back to a temp dir instead of crashing, and logs the fallback
Image and query caches function normally in the common case
userStories.notes: Evidence: CachedAsyncImage.swift:154 and QueryCache.swift:25 both do FileManager...urls(for:.cachesDirectory...).first! in launch-path singleton init.

userStories.title: Use cancellable structured concurrency for the App Store review prompt
userStories.description: As a user, I need the review prompt to not appear at an awkward moment so the delayed request is cancelled if I navigate away or background the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Review request uses Task.sleep, cancellable with the view, inside the existing .task
Only prompts when a foreground-active scene still exists
One-time gating (hasRequestedReview) preserved; no DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter in the launch path
userStories.notes: Evidence: DesMoinesInsiderApp.swift:146-152 uses DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline:.now()+2) to call AppStore.requestReview — fire-and-forget, no cancellation.

userStories.title: Expose favorite-button toggle state to VoiceOver
userStories.description: As a VoiceOver user, I need the heart/favorite button to announce its saved state so I can tell whether a card is already saved without re-reading the action verb.
acceptanceCriteria: Favorite button exposes .accessibilityValue reflecting saved/not-saved
.isSelected trait present when favorited
VoiceOver announces the state change after toggling without re-navigating
Pattern applied to all three card types (event, restaurant, attraction) and to share/remind buttons on detail screens
No change to visible label text or layout
userStories.notes: Evidence: CardFavoriteButton sets only .accessibilityLabel (ContentCard.swift:493) and flips the text; no .accessibilityValue / .isSelected trait — VoiceOver announces a plain button.

userStories.title: Raise favorite and filter-chip hit targets to 44pt
userStories.description: As a user, I need tap targets to meet Apple's 44pt minimum so the heart and removable filter chips are easy to hit accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: Heart button tap area >=44x44pt in all card variants (visual size may stay smaller, via .minHitTarget()/contentShape)
FilterChipView tap area >=44pt tall
.minHitTarget() reused rather than ad-hoc frames
Verified with Accessibility Inspector hit-target audit
userStories.notes: Evidence: ContentCard.swift:483-484 inline heart is 28x28pt (overlay 36pt), both under 44pt, no .minHitTarget() (helper exists at View+Accessibility.swift:12). FilterChipView.swift:31-32 ~28-32pt tall.

userStories.title: Announce toasts to VoiceOver and extend dismiss when VoiceOver is active
userStories.description: As a VoiceOver user, I need success/error/info toasts to be announced so I get feedback after favoriting, adding to calendar, or hitting an error.
acceptanceCriteria: Toast text announced via AccessibilityNotification.Announcement on appearance
Error toasts announced with higher priority
Auto-dismiss extended when UIAccessibility.isVoiceOverRunning
Existing ReduceMotion behavior unchanged
userStories.notes: Evidence: ToastOverlay.swift renders and auto-dismisses after 2s (91-99) but posts no accessibility announcement and adds no traits — silent for VoiceOver.

userStories.title: Show a failure/retry state and accessibility label for cached images
userStories.description: As a user, I need a failed image to show a distinguishable state with tap-to-retry and a meaningful VoiceOver label instead of a blank gray box.
acceptanceCriteria: Failed image shows a distinguishable broken/placeholder state (e.g. photo SF Symbol), not a blank gray box
Tapping a failed image retries loadImage()
CachedAsyncImage accepts an accessibility label; decorative usages are .accessibilityHidden(true)
Successful path and crossfade unchanged
userStories.notes: Evidence: CachedAsyncImage.swift:109-111 catch just sets isLoading=false -> bare Color(.systemGray5) placeholder (338); no a11y label on the image (26-50).

userStories.title: Add a reusable ErrorStateView and fix false-success refresh haptic
userStories.description: As a user, I need consistent offline/empty/error/loading states across list screens and a refresh haptic that reflects the real outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: Single ErrorStateView (icon + message + Retry) mirroring EmptyStateView, used by Home, Restaurants, Attractions
All three screens present the same offline/empty/error/loading structure
refresh() returns success/failure; .refreshable fires .success only on success, .error on failure
Retry action re-fetches and clears the error
userStories.notes: Evidence: RestaurantsView.swift:24-26 has an inline error banner; HomeView.swift:371-394 checks NetworkMonitor; AttractionsView has neither and AttractionsView.swift:80-83 always fires .success haptic after refresh regardless of outcome.

userStories.title: Give FilterSheet clear apply/cancel semantics and accessible sliders
userStories.description: As a user, I need the filter sheet to have clear apply/cancel behavior and VoiceOver-labeled sliders so I understand what changes and can read slider values.

Distance and rating sliders announce label + current value to VoiceOver
Selected category/date option buttons carry .isSelected
A single discoverable 'Clear all' remains

userStories.title: Surface active filter count on the filter entry point

acceptanceCriteria: Filter button shows the active count when > 0 (using existing viewModel.activeFilterCount)
Accessibility label includes the count (e.g. 'Filters, 3 active')
Consistent across Home, Restaurants, Attractions
No badge shown when zero filters active

userStories.title: Add password visibility toggle and field labels to AuthView
userStories.description: As a user signing up, I need a show/hide toggle on password fields and persistent field labels so I can verify entry and VoiceOver has context.

Each field has a persistent accessibility label independent of placeholder
Loading state announced and the submit button disabled during submit (via .brandLoading)
Email field keeps .keyboardType(.emailAddress)/content type
